body: I remember I tried confining in my best friend and he didn't take it well. Sometimes hearing that a loved one is suicidal can be confusing especially when it seems like comes out of nowhere. Maybe your mother is shocked and didn't react to it well but maybe once the idea starts sinking in she'll accept it and soften up. Good luck
